title: Deputy Chris Porritt's Myers-era testimony

tellings.quote: deputy sheriff, Chris Porritt, who went on record that long before the Shermans,

plain: Brandon Fugal, the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property famous for reports of strange events, tells Jesse Michels about a deputy sheriff named Chris Porritt. Fugal says Porritt went on record that strange things were going on at the ranch long before the Sherman family lived there, back in the 1980s when Kenneth and Edith Myers owned it. That would mean the ranch's oddities go back further than its best-known stories.
